name: Othmane Khelil
headline: co-CEO & Group COO at Bikeleasing & Probonio | International growth and Efficiency foundation | x-CHECK24 | x-Bain | MBA HEC Paris
summary:
Results-driven executive leading Technology, People, and Operations functions. My passion lies in building scalable systems, empowering teams, and driving digital transformation across fast-growing organizations.

With a background in top-tier strategy consulting (Bain), digital platforms (CHECK24), and product innovation, I bring a unique blend of strategic thinking and operational execution. I’ve led complex cross-functional initiatives, introduced AI and automation at scale, and implemented data-driven processes that unlock efficiency and growth.

What sets me apart:
	•	Ability to turn vision into scalable reality
	•	Deep expertise in digital operations, AI-enabled workflows, and organizational design
	•	A strong belief that culture and structure must grow together
	•	Track record of leading international teams and aligning global stakeholders

positions.title: Group co-CEO / Chief Operating Officer
positions.description:
- Prepared the company for international expansion into a large European market
→ Delivered a board-ready business plan, stakeholder map, and go-to-market framework
- Established a viable U.S. market connection via M&A
→ Built and sustained a strategic relationship with a U.S. target (minority investment context) and completed on-the-ground diligence
- Enabled cross-selling between Probonio and Bikeleasing through a shared digital platform
→ Defined and executed an integration roadmap, resolved legal and tax constraints, prioritized features, and created a scalable foundation for multi-product sales
- Supported a landmark acquisition by Decathlon
→ Contributed to strategic rationale and synergy logic, provided targeted pre-signing diligence input, and supported post-acquisition integration preparation
- Unified leadership standards across the group
→ Defined group-wide leadership principles, executed a structured engagement cascade (C-level, heads, team leads), and launched prioritized initiatives to systematically raise leadership quality
- Scaled Product & Engineering capacity and delivery speed
→ Redesigned the Product–Development operating model, doubled engineering capacity and increased throughput and execution speed
- Built a scalable insurance claims processing platform
→ Standardized workflows and decision logic across ~10 claim types, introduced AI-based document handling, and achieved ~20% efficiency gains in manual processing with ≥30% automation
- Increased AI adoption with regulatory-grade governance
→ Established an AI Excellence Cluster, rolled out mandatory risk and advanced capability training, implemented EU AI Act–aligned controls, and operationalized 30+ AI use cases across the organization

positions.title: Group Chief Operating Officer
positions.description:
- Rebuilt customer service end-to-end and introduced integrated platform stack (Zendesk + Aircall), introducing automation, AI copilot, and full system integrations
→ backlog reduced from ~2 weeks to 1 day and processing time −20% across all service channels
- Established the first real-time performance dashboards (Geckoboard, Superset)
→ Management decisions based on live throughput, backlog, and SLA metrics
- Extended opening times and integrated cross-border BPO
→ Availability increased; BPO share scaled from 0% to ~30% to stabilize peaks and cost base
- Introduced first production AI tools (chatbot and voicebot) in customer-facing operations
→ ~5% of requests handled by AI in early phase; foundation laid for scalable automation
- Transformed workforce and shift planning from fixed schedules to a fully flexible time model
→ ~80% reduction in fluctuation and measurable improvement in eNPS
- Removed structural and analog friction by eliminating fax channels, paper-based contracts, and a deputy team lead org layer
→ Faster decision-making, clearer accountability, and reduced operational drag

company.name: Bikeleasing-Service Deutschland
company.tagline: Dienstrad-Leasing leicht gemacht | Beste Konditionen für Arbeitgeber, Arbeitnehmer & Selbstständige
company.description:
Als Dienstrad-Anbieter fördert der Bikeleasing-Service nachhaltige und sozial gerechte Mobilität und ist damit in Deutschland seit 2015 und in Österreich seit 2020 auf steilem Erfolgskurs. Insgesamt nutzen im deutschsprachigen Raum bereits über 75.000 Unternehmen mit mehr als 3,7 Mio. Mitarbeitern den Bikeleasing-Service. 

In der DACH-Region arbeiten wir bereits mit über 8.000 Fahrrad- und E-Bike-Händlern zusammen.

Als Arbeitgeber beschäftigen wir im deutschsprachigen Raum mittlerweile über 400 Mitarbeiter – vor Ort an unseren sieben Standorten (Uslar, Vellmar, Innsbruck, Berlin, München, Freiburg, Landshut) sowie remote im Homeoffice. Dabei setzen wir auf faire Arbeitsbedingungen, abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben und Entwicklungsperspektiven sowie ein familienfreundliches Arbeitsumfeld, das beste Voraussetzungen für die Vereinbarkeit von Arbeit und Privatleben bietet. Als Team verbindet uns das Engagement für nachhaltige Mobilität und ein Miteinander, das von Wertschätzung und Toleranz geprägt ist.
